nodes.name: architect SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Architect skill for designing system architecture and scoping new features before implementation. Workflow: stop → read AGENTS.md → interview user (3 questions: users, V1 scope, data source) → propose design (DB, logic) → confirm with user → only then code. Ensures alignment with existing system before writing code.

nodes.name: audit SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Audit skill for systematic code review and quality assessment. Provides structured approach to reviewing code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability issues.

nodes.name: banner-design SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Banner design skill for creating effective visual banners and hero sections. Covers layout principles, typography, color psychology, CTA placement, and responsive considerations for marketing and product banners.

nodes.name: brand SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Brand skill for defining and maintaining brand identity: logo usage, color palette, typography, voice/tone, iconography, and brand application guidelines across touchpoints.

nodes.name: debug SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Debug skill for systematic troubleshooting: reproduce → isolate → hypothesize → test → fix → verify. Includes common patterns for frontend, backend, and integration debugging with logging and profiling strategies.

nodes.name: design SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Design skill for general UI/UX design decisions: layout systems, spacing scales, component architecture, design tokens, accessibility basics, and cross-platform consistency principles.

nodes.name: design-system SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Design system skill for building and maintaining component libraries: component anatomy, variant APIs, theming, documentation, versioning, and adoption metrics. Includes Figma-to-code workflow and token management.

nodes.name: karpathy-guidelines SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Karpathy Guidelines skill encoding behavioral principles to reduce LLM coding mistakes: 1) Think Before Coding (surface assumptions, ask when unclear), 2) Simplicity First (minimum code, no speculative abstractions), 3) Surgical Changes (touch only what's needed, match existing style), 4) Goal-Driven Execution (define verifiable success criteria, loop until verified). Tradeoff: biases toward caution over speed.

nodes.name: slides SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Slides skill for creating effective presentations: narrative structure, slide layouts, visual hierarchy, data visualization, speaker notes, and export formats. Covers storytelling frameworks and audience adaptation.

nodes.name: ui-styling SKILL.md
nodes.summary: UI Styling skill for CSS/styling decisions: methodology (BEM, utility-first, CSS-in-JS), responsive breakpoints, dark mode, animation principles, performance budgets, and framework-specific patterns (Tailwind, Styled Components, vanilla CSS).

nodes.name: ui-ux-pro-max SKILL.md
nodes.summary: UI/UX Pro Max skill - comprehensive design intelligence with searchable local data: 79 styles (50 active), 192 product palettes, 74 font pairings, 119 UX guidelines, 105 icons, 17 GSAP presets, 25 chart types, 22 stacks. Workflow: analyze requirements → design system (--design-system) or targeted domain search (--domain) or stack search (--stack). Covers accessibility, responsive, interaction, typography, color, charts, and stack-specific implementation. Python scripts for local search (no network).
